tour_seo_1.name: {name}
tour_seo_1.text: *We stand side by side in front of the school gate. The very spot where Seoyeon was waiting on Day 1.*

tour_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_2.text: This is where we first met.

tour_seo_3.name: {name}
tour_seo_3.text: Back then I said 'this is too much' — and almost got scolded.

tour_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_4.text: I didn't actually scold you, did I? — I liked you from that moment on.

tour_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_6.text: ...It might've been a trick of the wind.

tour_seo_8.name: {name}
tour_seo_8.text: *Seoyeon takes a small metal keychain from an inner pocket of her bag. It is shaped like the rooftop key, but has no grooves.*

tour_seo_10.name: {name}
tour_seo_10.text: The rooftop key... No, it isn't.

tour_seo_11.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_11.text: It's a student council souvenir. I have to return the real key today.

tour_seo_12.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_12.text: *She hands me the keychain. When our hands brush, Seoyeon readjusts the strap of her bag.*

tour_seo_13.name: {name}
tour_seo_13.text: Then how do we get onto the roof from now on?

tour_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_14.text: Ask me. We can borrow the real key and open it properly together.

tour_seo_freetalk.name: Seoyeon
tour_seo_freetalk.text: *She rests a hand on the rooftop railing and looks down at the school.* I didn't think we'd spend the last lunch break here, too.
tour_seo_freetalk.context: Day 5 last lunch, with Seoyeon. The end is approaching. Tone: Both know this is the last time. Laughing but with a tinge of bittersweetness. More honest than usual, everything feels precious.
tour_seo_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool student council president. Being the last time, her usual composure is gone and true feelings emerge.

tour_seo_end.name: {name}
tour_seo_end.text: *I slip Seoyeon's keychain into my pocket. The real rooftop key knocks once more inside her bag.*

tour_yuna_1.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. An old sofa, afternoon sunlight through the window. The same dusty smell as when you first walked in.*

tour_yuna_1b.name: {name}
tour_yuna_1b.text: *The library annex. The secret reading space shared with Yuna. An old sofa, afternoon sunlight streaming through the window.*

tour_yuna_2.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_2.text: *She sits on the sofa. She leaves the seat beside her empty. A spot where no dust has settled.*

tour_yuna_3.name: {name}
tour_yuna_3.text: When I come here, the outside sounds seem a little distant.

tour_yuna_6.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_6.text: *She pulls a notebook from her bag. The same one hastily covered in the attic.*

tour_yuna_8.name: {name}
tour_yuna_8.text: You said it back then. 'Writing the ending means it ends.'

tour_yuna_9.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_9.text: If it's not an ending — but the start of a new story — I thought that'd be okay.

tour_yuna_10.name: {name}
tour_yuna_10.text: *Holds out the note. My hands are shaking slightly. Yuna cannot place the corner of the cover all the way.*

tour_yuna_freetalk.name: Yuna
tour_yuna_freetalk.text: *She runs her fingertips along the book spines, then lifts her head.* Since it's the last time, I'm talking more than usual.
tour_yuna_freetalk.context: Day 5 last lunch, with Yuna. The end is approaching. Tone: Both know this is the last time. Laughing but with a tinge of bittersweetness. More honest than usual, everything feels precious.
tour_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is a mysterious literary girl. Being the last time, her walls are completely down. Her sentences are much longer than usual.

tour_yuna_end_2.name: {name}
tour_yuna_end_2.text: *'For now.' — That's the most Yuna can promise.*

tour_dain_1.name: {name}
tour_dain_1.text: *The gym. Beside the line where we made our first bet stands the ball rack we filled last night. Today, the lights are on.*

tour_dain_1b.name: {name}
tour_dain_1b.text: *The gym. A place filled with countless bets and spikes over the past few days. — The lights are on today.*

tour_dain_2.name: Dain
tour_dain_2.text: *She is standing in the middle of the court. Holding a volleyball.*

tour_dain_4.name: {name}
tour_dain_4.text: You're just going to lose again.

tour_dain_8.name: {name}
tour_dain_8.text: *Smiling even when angry. Dain puts the volleyball down on the court. slowly.*

tour_dain_10.name: Dain
tour_dain_10.text: Going pro... I don't know about that anymore.

tour_dain_11_b.name: Dain
tour_dain_11_b.text: I used to think if volleyball was gone, I'd be empty too. Lately — it's not like that.

tour_dain_12.name: Dain
tour_dain_12.text: Dunno what changed. ...But I can see myself off the court now, too.

tour_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
tour_dain_freetalk.text: *She stops the volleyball with her toe and grins.* Even if it's the last lunch, I can't just let it pass.
tour_dain_freetalk.context: Day 5 last lunch, with Dain. The end is approaching. Tone: Both know this is the last time. Laughing but with a tinge of bittersweetness. More honest than usual, everything feels precious.
tour_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Being the last time, she can't maintain her cheerful facade. Real emotions show through.

tour_dain_end_2.name: {name}
tour_dain_end_2.text: *She speaks without exclamation marks. This time she doesn't bow her head. Dain's hand rests on the volleyball, not on her knee.*
